en.title: Corpse Scriptures: Judgment of the Appointed Hour
en.premise: Sigilists, who wield supernatural powers by engraving word-spirits onto their bodies, clash over a forbidden scripture capable of rewriting the laws of the world. The protagonist is a fallen sorcerer possessing a 'broken pocket watch' that can locally freeze time—at the cost of his own memories. Guided by the 'voices of the dead' emanating from a radio at dawn, he plunges into a desperate struggle to rescue a young girl's soul.

zh.title: 骸之经典，刻限之断罪
zh.premise: 将“言灵”刻在身体上以发挥异能的“刻印师”们，为了争夺能够改写世界之理的禁忌经典而陷入纷争。主人公是一名落魄的咒术师，他拥有一块能以记忆为代价局部停止时间的“破旧怀表”。在黎明时分从收音机中传出的“死者之声”的指引下，他投身于一场为了拯救一名少女灵魂的绝望战斗之中。
